Clindamycin Phosphate & Adapalene Gel

Advanced Microsphere Technology | Anti-Acne Topical Gel | 20 gm

Product Overview

AVqlin AD Gel is a topical dermatological preparation combining Clindamycin Phosphate and Adapalene, designed for the management of acne vulgaris.
The formulation features Advanced Microsphere Technology, designed to support uniform distribution of the active ingredients and consistent topical application.

Key Benefits

Helps manage acne vulgaris
Helps reduce acne-associated inflammatory lesions
Adapalene helps normalize follicular keratinization
Clindamycin provides topical antibacterial activity
Advanced Microsphere Technology supports uniform topical application
Convenient combination of complementary anti-acne actions

Key Ingredients & Role

Adapalene

A topical retinoid that helps normalize abnormal follicular cell turnover and helps prevent formation of comedonal lesions.

Clindamycin Phosphate

A topical lincosamide antibiotic that provides antibacterial activity against acne-associated bacteria and helps manage inflammation.

Why AVqlin AD?

Dual-Action Acne Management
Combines the complementary actions of Adapalene + Clindamycin Phosphate in a single topical formulation.
Advanced Microsphere Technology
A sophisticated formulation approach designed to support uniform dispersion and consistent delivery of the active ingredients across the treated area.

Indication

For the topical management of acne vulgaris, as directed by the physician.

Directions for Use

Apply a thin layer to the affected area as directed by the dermatologist/physician.
For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes, lips and mucosal surfaces.

Safety Information

Use only as directed by the physician.
Initial dryness, redness, peeling or irritation may occur.
Avoid excessive sun exposure and use suitable sunscreen during treatment.
Do not apply to severely irritated or damaged skin unless advised by a physician.

Keep out of reach of children.

Storage
Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight and excessive heat. Keep the container tightly closed.



ISOTRIQ-20

Isotretinoin Capsules IP 20 mg

Oral Retinoid Therapy | Severe Acne Management | 20 mg

Product Overview

ISOTRIQ-20 is an oral dermatological formulation containing Isotretinoin 20 mg, a systemic retinoid used for the treatment of severe, treatment-resistant acne vulgaris.

It works by reducing sebaceous gland activity, controlling excess sebum production and targeting key factors involved in acne development.

Key Benefits

- Helps manage severe, treatment-resistant acne vulgaris
- Significantly reduces excess sebum production
- Helps reduce inflammatory acne lesions
- Supports normalization of follicular keratinization
- Helps reduce the formation of new acne lesions
- Provides a systemic treatment option for severe acne under specialist supervision

Key Ingredient & Role

Isotretinoin IP 20 mg

A systemic retinoid derived from vitamin A that acts on multiple factors involved in acne development.

Its primary actions include:

- Reducing sebaceous gland size and activity
- Decreasing excessive sebum secretion
- Normalizing follicular keratinization
- Reducing acne-associated inflammation

Why ISOTRIQ-20?

Multi-Targeted Acne Management

Isotretinoin addresses four major factors involved in acne:

- Sebum Regulation: Reduces excessive oil production.
- Follicular Normalization: Helps prevent clogged pores.
- Anti-Inflammatory Action: Helps reduce acne-associated inflammation.
- Acne Bacterial Environment: Reduced sebum indirectly creates less favorable conditions for C. acnes proliferation.

Indication

For the treatment of severe, treatment-resistant acne vulgaris, including severe nodular acne, under specialist medical supervision.

Directions for Use

Take orally strictly as prescribed by the dermatologist. Dosage and treatment duration depend on individual patient requirements and clinical assessment.

Prescription medicine. Not intended for self-medication.

Safety Information

- Strictly contraindicated during pregnancy due to the risk of severe birth defects.
- Effective pregnancy prevention and pregnancy testing are required for patients who can become pregnant, according to the prescribing protocol.
- May cause dryness of lips, skin and eyes.
- Liver function and lipid levels require monitoring as advised by the physician.
- Avoid vitamin A supplements and tetracycline antibiotics unless specifically assessed by the prescribing specialist.
- Do not donate blood during treatment and for at least one month after stopping treatment.
- Use only under the supervision of a qualified dermatologist.

Storage

Store in a cool, dry and dark place below 25°C, protected from direct sunlight, heat and moisture.


ROOTRIQ PRO Hair Serum

Advanced Clinically Studied Actives Complex

Hair Growth Serum | For All Hair Types | Suitable for Men & Women | 50 ml

PRODUCT OVERVIEW

ROOTRIQ PRO Hair Serum is an advanced multi-active hair serum formulated to reduce hair fall, support hair growth, improve hair density and strengthen hair roots. Its powerful combination of clinically studied hair-growth actives and scalp-supporting ingredients provides comprehensive care for healthier-looking hair.

KEY ACTIVES

PROCAPIL® 3%
Helps reduce hair fall and supports stronger hair anchoring.

REDENSYL® 3%
Supports hair density and promotes healthy hair growth.

ANAGAIN™ 2%
Helps revitalize hair follicles and support the natural hair-growth cycle.

FOLLICUSAN™ 1%
Helps nourish and strengthen the hair-root environment.

RICE EXOSOME 1%
Supports scalp renewal and a healthy scalp environment.

ROOT BIOTECH
Advanced botanical active supporting hair follicle and scalp care.

ANAGELIN
Helps support hair follicle vitality and healthy hair growth.

CAFFEINE
Supports scalp and hair-root care and a healthy hair-growth environment.

BIOTIN
Supports healthy-looking and stronger hair.

KEY BENEFITS

• Helps reduce hair fall
• Supports hair growth
• Helps improve hair density
• Helps strengthen hair roots
• Supports a healthy scalp environment
• Helps maintain the natural hair-growth cycle

DIRECTIONS FOR USE

Apply a generous amount directly onto the scalp and massage gently with fingertips. Use AM/PM as directed.

SAFETY INFORMATION

For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. In case of irritation or rash, discontinue use and consult a dermatologist. A patch test is recommended before first use.

ROOTRIQ PRO — Advanced Actives for Stronger Roots, Reduced Hair Fall & Healthier-Looking Hair.

LUMIRIQ AC

Clarifying Face Wash | For Acne & Skin Rejuvenation | 75 ml

PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Lumiriq AC is a refreshing clarifying face wash formulated with Potassium Azeloyl Diglycinate, Glycolic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Niacinamide, Zinc PCA and Witch Hazel. It gently cleanses the skin while helping control excess oil, refine pores and improve the appearance of acne-prone skin.

KEY ACTIVES

Potassium Azeloyl Diglycinate
Helps support oil control and skin clarification.

Salicylic Acid
Helps unclog pores and remove excess buildup.

Glycolic Acid
Provides gentle exfoliation and helps refine skin texture.

Niacinamide
Helps support skin clarity and the skin barrier.

Zinc PCA
Helps control excess oil and supports acne-prone skin.

Witch Hazel
Helps soothe the skin and supports excess oil control.

KEY BENEFITS

• Deep cleansing
• Helps control excess oil
• Helps refine and unclog pores
• Supports clearer-looking skin
• Helps improve skin texture
• Suitable for oily and acne-prone skin

HOW TO USE

Wet your face and dispense a small amount of Lumiriq AC Face Wash onto your fingertips. Gently massage over the face in circular motions, avoiding the eye area. Rinse thoroughly with water and pat dry.

SAFETY INFORMATION

For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes and mouth. If irritation or rash occurs, discontinue use and consult a dermatologist.

LUMIRIQ AC — Cleanse • Clarify • Refine

ROOTRIQ-H Tablets

Therapeutic-Dose Hair Nutrition Formula | 10 Tablets

PRODUCT OVERVIEW

ROOTRIQ-H is a therapeutic-dose nutritional formula combining Biotin, N-Acetyl L-Cysteine, Calcium Pantothenate, Selenium, Copper, Zinc, Manganese and Folic Acid. It is designed to provide targeted nutritional support for healthy hair growth, stronger hair roots and overall hair wellness.

KEY ACTIVES

D-Biotin
Supports healthy hair growth and stronger-looking hair.

N-Acetyl L-Cysteine
Provides cysteine support for healthy keratin formation.

Calcium Pantothenate
Supports nutritional requirements for healthy hair maintenance.

Selenium
Provides antioxidant nutritional support for hair and scalp.

Zinc
Supports normal hair and scalp health.

Copper
Supports normal hair pigmentation and connective tissue health.

Manganese
Provides essential nutritional support for connective tissue and hair health.

Folic Acid
Supports normal cell growth and renewal.

THERAPEUTIC-DOSE FORMULA

A carefully formulated combination of essential vitamins, minerals and amino-acid support designed to provide targeted nutritional support for hair health.

KEY BENEFITS

• Supports healthy hair growth
• Helps provide targeted hair nutrition
• Supports stronger hair roots
• Supports healthy hair structure
• Helps maintain overall hair and scalp wellness

DIRECTIONS FOR USE

Take as directed by the physician.

SAFETY INFORMATION

Use under medical guidance. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry and dark place. Protect from direct sunlight and moisture.

ROOTRIQ-H — Therapeutic-Dose Nutritional Support for Healthy Hair.


ATARIQ 25

Hydroxyzine Hydrochloride Tablets I.P. 25 mg

Antihistamine | Anti-Pruritic Therapy | 10 × 10 Tablets

PRODUCT OVERVIEW

ATARIQ 25 contains Hydroxyzine Hydrochloride 25 mg, an antihistamine used for the management of itching and allergic skin conditions. It provides effective symptomatic relief under medical supervision.

KEY BENEFITS

• Helps relieve itching and pruritus
• Helps manage symptoms associated with allergic skin conditions
• Provides antihistaminic action
• Supports symptomatic relief of allergy-related discomfort

KEY INGREDIENT

Hydroxyzine Hydrochloride I.P. 25 mg

An antihistamine that helps reduce the effects of histamine and provides relief from itching and allergic symptoms.

DIRECTIONS FOR USE

Take as directed by the physician.

SAFETY INFORMATION

Prescription medicine. Use only under medical supervision. May cause drowsiness or sedation. Avoid driving or operating machinery if affected. Avoid alcohol unless advised otherwise by your physician.

Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture.

ATARIQ 25 — Targeted Relief for Itching & Allergic Skin Symptoms.


UVRIQ Whipped Invisible Sunscreen

SPF 50+ | PA+++ | Broad Spectrum UVA & UVB Protection | 50 gm

PRODUCT OVERVIEW

UVRIQ Whipped Invisible Sunscreen is an ultra-light, non-greasy sunscreen formulated to provide broad-spectrum UVA & UVB protection. Its lightweight whipped texture offers a fast-absorbing, invisible finish without leaving a white cast.

KEY ACTIVES

Niacinamide
Helps support the skin barrier and overall skin appearance.

Vitamin E
Provides antioxidant support and helps maintain skin conditioning.

Alpha Glucosyl Rutin
Provides antioxidant support and complements daily skin protection.

KEY FEATURES

• SPF 50+ broad-spectrum protection
• PA+++ UVA protection
• Photostable UV filter system
• Ultra-light whipped texture
• Fast absorbing
• Non-greasy finish
• No white cast
• Non-comedogenic
• Suitable for all skin types

HOW TO USE

Apply generously and evenly to the face and exposed skin as the last step of your morning skincare routine. Reapply as required, especially after sweating or prolonged sun exposure.

SAFETY INFORMATION

For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes. If irritation occurs, discontinue use and consult a dermatologist.

UVRIQ — Whipped Invisible Protection for Everyday Sun Care.


LUMIRIQ GLOW

Brightening & Pigmentation Care Face Wash | 75 g

PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Lumiriq Glow is a gentle, sulphate-free brightening face wash formulated with advanced pigmentation-care actives to help reduce the appearance of pigmentation, even skin tone and maintain skin hydration. It provides gentle cleansing while leaving the skin fresh, smooth and radiant.

KEY ACTIVES

Clair BLANCHE-III™
A premium multi-active brightening complex by Ichimaru Pharcos, Japan, designed to target multiple pathways involved in pigmentation and support a brighter, more even-looking complexion.

B-White™ (Oligopeptide-68)
An advanced brightening peptide by Clariant, designed to support melanin regulation and improve the appearance of uneven pigmentation.

Kojic Acid Dipalmitate
Helps support pigmentation control and brighter-looking skin.

Alpha Arbutin
Helps reduce the appearance of pigmentation and uneven skin tone.

Niacinamide
Helps improve skin clarity and supports the skin barrier.

Licorice Extract
Helps soothe the skin and supports a brighter, more even-looking complexion.

KEY BENEFITS

• Helps reduce the appearance of pigmentation
• Helps even skin tone
• Provides gentle cleansing
• Helps maintain skin hydration
• Supports brighter, clearer-looking skin
• Suitable for daily use

KEY FEATURES

• Sulphate Free
• Gentle & Non-Stripping
• Dermatologically Tested
• Suitable for All Skin Types

HOW TO USE

Wet your face, take a small amount of Lumiriq Glow Face Wash and gently massage over the face in circular motions. Rinse thoroughly with water and pat dry.

SAFETY INFORMATION

For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If irritation or rash occurs, discontinue use and consult a dermatologist.

LUMIRIQ GLOW — Cleanse • Brighten • Even


ROOTRIQ AHF

Hair Strengthening Shampoo | Advanced Hair Formula

PRODUCT OVERVIEW

ROOTRIQ AHF is an advanced hair-strengthening shampoo formulated with Redensyl® & AnaGain™ Complex, Hydrolyzed Protein, Caffeine, Zinc PCA and Panthenol. It gently cleanses the scalp while helping reduce hair fall, strengthen hair and maintain a healthy scalp environment.

KEY ACTIVES

Redensyl®
Helps support the natural hair-growth cycle and promotes healthier-looking hair.

AnaGain™
Helps support hair follicle activity and the natural hair-growth cycle.

Hydrolyzed Protein
Helps strengthen and condition the hair fibre while improving hair texture.

Caffeine
Provides scalp and hair-root support for healthier-looking hair.

Zinc PCA
Helps balance excess scalp oil and supports a healthy scalp environment.

Panthenol
Helps moisturize, condition and improve the smoothness of hair.

KEY BENEFITS

• Helps reduce hair fall
• Strengthens weak and fragile hair
• Helps nourish hair roots
• Supports a healthy scalp environment
• Helps improve hair texture and manageability
• Helps maintain stronger, healthier-looking hair

HOW TO USE

Wet hair thoroughly. Apply an adequate amount of ROOTRIQ AHF to the scalp and hair. Gently massage into a rich lather and rinse thoroughly. Repeat if required. Use regularly for best results.

SAFETY INFORMATION

For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If irritation or rash occurs, discontinue use and consult a dermatologist.

ROOTRIQ AHF — Strengthen • Nourish • Balance


LUMIRIQ AC

Clarifying Face Serum | Multi-Active Complex | For Acne-Prone Skin | 30 ml

PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Lumiriq AC is a multi-active clarifying face serum formulated for acne-prone skin. Its advanced combination of Salicylic Acid, Niacinamide, Zinc PCA and ACZero™ helps unclog pores, control excess oil, reduce the appearance of acne marks and support a healthy skin barrier. Enriched with Hyaluronic Acid, Aquaxyl™ and Ceramide Complex for balanced hydration and skin comfort.

KEY ACTIVES

Salicylic Acid
Helps unclog pores and remove excess buildup for clearer-looking skin.

Niacinamide
Helps reduce the appearance of acne marks and supports skin clarity.

Zinc PCA
Helps control excess oil and supports acne-prone skin.

ACZero™
Provides anti-acne and soothing support for clearer, calmer-looking skin.

Hyaluronic Acid
Helps provide deep hydration and maintain skin moisture.

Aquaxyl™
Supports long-lasting moisture and hydration.

Ceramide Complex
Helps strengthen and support the skin barrier.

KEY BENEFITS

• Helps unclog pores
• Helps control acne and excess oil
• Helps reduce the appearance of acne marks
• Supports a healthy skin barrier
• Provides balanced hydration
• Helps soothe acne-prone skin
• Promotes clearer, smoother-looking skin

HOW TO USE

Cleanse your face with a gentle facial cleanser and pat dry. Apply a small amount of Lumiriq AC serum onto the palm or directly onto the desired areas. Gently massage until fully absorbed. Follow with a moisturizer if required.

SAFETY INFORMATION

For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If irritation or rash occurs, discontinue use and consult a dermatologist.

LUMIRIQ AC — Cleanse • Correct • Repair

import path from "node:path";

/**
 * Server-only helpers for real product media in `public/products/`.
 *
 * Real assets follow a strict naming convention so a slug is all that is
 * needed: `<slug>.jpg` for the packshot photo, `<slug>.mp4` for the product
 * film. A product may ship with either, both, or neither — pages should ask
 * these helpers instead of guessing.
 *
 * Not safe to import from client components (uses `node:fs`).
 */

const MEDIA_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "products");

function exists(file: string): boolean {
  try {
    return fs.existsSync(path.join(MEDIA_DIR, file));
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** True when a real `<slug>.mp4` product film is present. */
export function hasProductVideo(slug: string): boolean {
  return exists(`${slug}.mp4`);
}

/** True when a real `<slug>.jpg` packshot photo is present. */
export function hasProductPhoto(slug: string): boolean {
  return exists(`${slug}.jpg`);
}

/** Public URL of the product film. Only meaningful when `hasProductVideo` is true. */
export function productVideoSrc(slug: string): string {
  return `/products/${slug}.mp4`;
}

/** Public URL of the packshot, or `null` when none exists. */
export function productPhotoSrc(slug: string): string | null {
  return hasProductPhoto(slug) ? `/products/${slug}.jpg` : null;
}

      .then((r) => {

+import fs from "node:fs";
+import path from "node:path";
+
+/**
+ * Server-only helpers for real product media in `public/products/`.
+ *
+ * Real assets follow a strict naming convention so a slug is all that is
+ * needed: `<slug>.jpg` for the packshot photo, `<slug>.mp4` for the product
+ * film. A product may ship with either, both, or neither — pages should ask
+ * these helpers instead of guessing.
+ *
+ * Not safe to import from client components (uses `node:fs`).
+ */
+
+const MEDIA_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "products");
+
+function exists(file: string): boolean {
+  try {
+    return fs.existsSync(path.join(MEDIA_DIR, file));
+  } catch {
+    return false;
+  }
+}
+
+/** True when a real `<slug>.mp4` product film is present. */
+export function hasProductVideo(slug: string): boolean {
+  return exists(`${slug}.mp4`);
+}
+
+/** True when a real `<slug>.jpg` packshot photo is present. */
+export function hasProductPhoto(slug: string): boolean {
+  return exists(`${slug}.jpg`);
+}
+
+/** Public URL of the product film. Only meaningful when `hasProductVideo` is true. */
+export function productVideoSrc(slug: string): string {
+  return `/products/${slug}.mp4`;
+}
+
+/** Public URL of the packshot, or `null` when none exists. */
+export function productPhotoSrc(slug: string): string | null {
+  return hasProductPhoto(slug) ? `/products/${slug}.jpg` : null;
+}

The Four Pillars of Averiq's Quality Control
Operating as a brand-building entity rather than a direct manufacturer requires exceptional oversight. Our selection and monitoring processes are among the most rigorous in the industry. No product enters the Averiq portfolio until it clears these four critical steps:

Step 1: Elite Partner Selection
We collaborate exclusively with state-of-the-art, WHO-GMP-certified manufacturing units. Before initiating any partnership, we meticulously evaluate the facility's audit history, certifications, and past compliance records to ensure they meet our exacting corporate standards.

Step 2: Scientific Formulation Review
Whether it is our current advanced dermatological range or our upcoming Dental and Gynecology divisions, every formulation is thoroughly vetted. Active ingredients, compositional balance, and product stability are verified against the latest clinical needs and medical research.

Step 3: Absolute Regulatory Compliance
We strictly adhere to all Indian cosmetic and pharmaceutical regulations. Every product label, packaging design, and therapeutic claim undergoes a rigorous legal and clinical review.
